mapper.select: SELECT r.ROOM_ID, r.MEMBER_ID, m.MEMBER_NAME, r.STATUS, r.CREATED_AT, r.UPDATED_AT FROM CHAT_ROOM r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE r.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY r.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT r.ROOM_ID, r.MEMBER_ID, m.MEMBER_NAME, r.STATUS, r.CREATED_AT, r.UPDATED_AT FROM CHAT_ROOM r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID WHERE r.ROOM_ID = #{roomId}

SELECT r.ROOM_ID, r.MEMBER_ID, m.MEMBER_NAME, r.STATUS, r.CREATED_AT, r.UPDATED_AT, (SELECT CONTENT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = r.ROOM_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT 1) AS LAST_MESSAGE FROM CHAT_ROOM r JOIN MEMBER m ON r.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID ORDER BY r.UPDATED_AT DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE (ROOM_ID, SENDER_ROLE, CONTENT) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{senderRole}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT MESSAGE_ID, ROOM_ID, SENDER_ROLE, CONTENT, CREATED_AT FROM CHAT_MESSAGE WHERE ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT ASC
